question: In December 2020, Odisha tourism launched its flagship Eco-Retreat program at five locations. Which of the following is NOT a part of them?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Gopalpur__.**

__
 
• In December 2020, **Odisha tourism** launched its **flagship Eco-Retreat program** at five locations, **Gopalpur** is **NOT **a part of them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Odisha Tourism **launched its flagship **Eco-Retreat program** at **5 locations** in the State.
 
• The event, inaugurated by **Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik **through virtual mode, aims at boosting tourism in the State.
 
• The five locations, namely **Konark, Satakosia, Bhitarkanika, Daringibadi,** and **Hirakud **under the scheme are open to the tourists till February next year.
 
• Under the program, accommodation facilities and services will be provided to tourists in luxury cottages in the identified locations. 
 
• **Odisha**
